description: This file provides support for interfacing with the Novita AI API, an OpenAI-compatible chat completion endpoint. It defines a configuration class for validating environment parameters specific to Novita AI, extending from a base OpenAI chat configuration.

classes.name: NovitaConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up and validating environment parameters specific to Novita AI integration, extending from OpenAIGPTConfig.

methods.description: Validates and sets environment parameters such as API key, headers, and model-specific options required for interacting with Novita AI's chat API.
